title: Mirror Tempest Gate: First Pressure
description: Mirror Tempest Gate unfolds across tempest mirror gate where false lanes split from sacred ground, pushing a 5-Titan Kami Titan to prove precise control, repositioning, evasion, spirit terrain, disciplined burst. without violating established Realm canon.
